ascii.description: ASCII-only. NFD-normalizes and strips all combining marks and non-ASCII characters. Safe for any ESC/POS printer regardless of firmware.

utf8.description: UTF-8 pass-through. Only strips raw ESC/POS control bytes (0x00-0x08, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0E-0x1F, 0x7F). Requires printer firmware with Unicode/UTF-8 support.

cp852.description: CP852 (Central European) codepage mapping. Applies explicit character table for Polish, Czech, Slovak, Hungarian, and common Latin Extended characters before falling back to '?' for anything unmapped.

translit.description: Romanizes Georgian, Cyrillic, Greek, Armenian and Hebrew to Latin, then applies the ASCII path. For printers with no codepage for the local script, where the alternative is a blank line.
